+load(configuration, assets: LoadedAssets, factories: SceneModuleFactory[], signal: AbortSignal): Promise<boolean>
create() and load() dispose the engine before throwing.
load() takes ownership of assets and registers each module
before awaiting build(). On abort it returns false and sweeps
the scene when the pending build settles.
Frame errors and context loss go through fatal(error),
which calls dispose() before notifying the viewer.
dispose() stops the loop, aborts the build and disconnects
the observer and listener. It disposes modules in reverse
order, then releases scene resources, assets and renderer.
It also releases the WebGL context. Cleanup continues after
individual errors and tracks resources already released.

Contract: build() receives context.signal, checks it before
and after every await, and releases any late result if aborted.
It must settle on abort; dispose() is safe/idempotent during
a partial or pending build. update() allocates nothing per frame.
